# [9.1.0] Child theme translations are not displayed in Back Office translation UI

In PrestaShop **9.1.0**, when editing translations for a child theme from Back Office, the child theme translations are not displayed.

The issue seems to come from `src/PrestaShopBundle/Controller/Api/TranslationController.php` in `listDomainTranslationAction()`: child themes are routed to `CoreDomainProviderDefinition` instead of `ThemeProviderDefinition`, even though the tree is built with the selected child theme.

As a result:

the translation tree can be loaded
but opening a domain does not show the child theme translations
in some cases `TranslationFilesNotFoundException` may also occur earlier depending on file filtering
Expected behavior:

core themes should use core translations
child/custom themes should load translations through ThemeProviderDefinition
child theme translations should be visible in the BO translation editor

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fbace977-3308-40a5-a31e-2a52d5facc91

linked to: https://github.com/PrestaShop/autoupgrade/issues/1764

## Étapes
1. Install one of the two attached themes [hummingbird-child.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26411078/hummingbird-child.zip) - [classic-child.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26411079/classic-child.zip)
2. Go to **International > Translations**
- In **Type of translation**, select Front office Translations
- In **Select your theme**, choose classic-child or hummingbird-child
- Select a language to translate
3. Click "**Modify**"



You will now see the issue.

RÈGLES D'ARCHITECTURE & CONVENTIONS PRESTASHOP :
1. DUALITÉ LEGACY / SYMFONY (Où chercher ?) :
   - Legacy : classes/Nom.php (déclarée 'class NomCore extends ObjectModel'). Attention : le fichier est classes/Nom.php, JAMAIS NomCore.php.
   - Contrôleurs Legacy : controllers/admin/AdminNomController.php ou controllers/front/NomController.php.
   - Moderne Symfony : src/Core/ (Domain, CQRS, Grid, QueryBuilder) et src/PrestaShopBundle/ (Contrôleurs, Form Types).
   - Ponts Symfony ↔ Legacy : src/Adapter/ (CommandHandlers, Repositories).
2. TEMPLATES & VUES :
   - Back-Office moderne : src/PrestaShopBundle/Resources/views/Admin/**/*.html.twig
   - Legacy BO / FO / PDF : admin-dev/themes/**/*.tpl, themes/classic/**/*.tpl, pdf/*.tpl
3. MULTIBOUTIQUE (MULTISHOP) :
   - Les tables de données ont souvent une table déclinée ps_*_shop (ex: ps_product_shop, ps_country_shop, ps_category_shop).
   - Toujours filtrer ou joindre avec contextShopIds, Shop::isFeatureActive(), ou Context::getContext()->shop->id.
4. HOOKS & DISPATCHERS :
   - Legacy : Hook::exec('actionNomHook', $params).
   - Symfony Grids : action{GridId}GridQueryBuilderModifier via HookDispatcherInterface.
5. DÉNORMALISATION & STOCKS :
   - Stocks réels et virtuels : table ps_stock_available (géré via StockAvailable::setQuantity).
   - Recherche rapide : tables ps_search_word et ps_search_index (moteur Levenshtein dans classes/Search.php).
6. ÉDITION SÉCURISÉE :
   - Toujours copier les lignes exactes dans SEARCH. Utiliser pSQL() sur les variables dans les requêtes SQL brutes.


ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).

RÉSULTATS DE RECHERCHE (fichier, nb de lignes)
src/PrestaShopBundle/Controller/Api/TranslationController.php (2)

ÉTAPE 2 LIRE. Réponds en JSON : {"files": ["..."]} (1 à 3 fichiers).
